workarounds.note: clearMeasurementCache() is called with no argument: in 1.4.1 it takes none and empties the global width caches, while the docs' 'Measurement cache' section shows clearMeasurementCache(cache)
every fontFamily names one family: a CSS stack is read as a single family that does not exist and measures with a fallback, with no warning (gotcha font-family-one-name)
the H1 breakBefore is restated because any headings object drops it (gotcha headings-drop-h1-break)
col() writes the palette hex beside each paletteId: 1.4.1 paints opener, header and footer elements from the inline hex (gotcha palette-skips-designs)
the opener's design texts give lineHeight as a multiple (1, 1.05, 1.35), never pt(): a dimension drops the opener's reservation (gotcha design-lineheight-multiple)

the H1 level sets span: 'page' so its bleed-anchored field reaches the top edge. A heading design kept in the column is clipped at the top margin, although page- and bleed-anchored elements still paint into the side margins; here the clip would cut the head of the field and hide the kicker, with no warning
